contracts.name: First Scale-Up
contracts.flavour: A regional logistics chain wants their whole ops stack rewritten by someone who has clearly never done this before. You have not.

contracts.name: Million Token Operator
contracts.flavour: Train the first planetary-scale model. Or a very convincing imitation of one, if that is faster.

contracts.name: Regional Compute Provider
contracts.flavour: Every startup in the business park wants inference and none of them want to buy a machine. You are now the utility, and utilities do not get to have an outage.

contracts.name: Data Centre Magnate
contracts.flavour: Rewrite the entire public internet. Twice, because the first pass introduced a recursion bug that rewrote itself.

contracts.name: National Backbone
contracts.flavour: Operate a nation's AI infrastructure for one round. The nation would like this to be quieter than it sounds.

contracts.name: The Monopoly
contracts.flavour: Route 80% of global AI traffic through your infrastructure. The remaining 20% is a rounding error you plan to acquire.

contracts.name: The Final Prompt
contracts.flavour: Process "The Final Prompt" and become the default inference layer for civilisation. Support is not included.

contracts.name: The Singularity
contracts.flavour: Train a model capable of recursively improving itself. Legal has asked that we not call it that in the contract.

contracts.name: The Archive
contracts.flavour: Process and preserve all human knowledge. Some of it was already wrong; that part processes fastest.

contracts.name: The Simulation
contracts.flavour: Simulate an entire civilisation. It has already started asking questions about its render distance.

contracts.name: The Ad Machine
contracts.flavour: Generate every advert every human will ever see. Reputation is not a load-bearing requirement here.
